ads_ratio.reason: EDGAR per-share figures are per ordinary (common) share while the Nasdaq/NYSE price is per ADS; per-share figures must be scaled x5/9 ordinary shares per ADS to be comparable to the ADS price. Without this the preliminary run overstated IV roughly 1.8x.
ads_ratio.source: SK Telecom Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-29), cover page: the registered American Depositary Shares are 'each representing five-ninths of one share of Common Stock' (NYSE: SKM) — i.e. 5/9 ordinary share per ADS, the ratio in place since the October 2021 5-for-1 stock split (par W500 to W100)

moat_against: Saturated market, government tariff pressure — no demonstrated pricing power; KRW revenue CAGR negative over 3 and 5 years
April 2025 cybersecurity breach: FY2025 operating income -41.1% YoY, net income -73.0% — trust and remediation costs are live
KT and LG U+ contest every segment; share gains are bought with subsidies/marketing
Chaebol governance and KRW depreciation — USD revenue fell ~10% in FY2024 on FX alone in the engine's converted series
moat_for: Korea's #1 mobile carrier: spectrum, network scale and brand in a concentrated three-player market
ROIC proxy recovered to 13.6% by FY2024 (11.9% FY2022, 12.6% FY2023) after the SK Square spin-off
SK Broadband fixed-line/IPTV bundle plus enterprise ICT — recurring, contracted revenue
AIDC growth engine: AI data-center revenue +34.9% YoY in FY2025, Ulsan AIDC with AWS under construction
moat_justification: South Korea's largest mobile carrier with spectrum/network scale, the leading brand, SK Broadband fixed-line/IPTV and a fast-growing AI data-center business (AIDC revenue +34.9% YoY in FY2025), and ROIC proxy that recovered to 11.9%/12.6%/13.6% in FY2022-24 (fundamentals.json) after the SK Square spin-off shrank the equity base. Against: a saturated, three-player market (KT, LG U+) with government tariff pressure and no real pricing power, KRW revenue CAGR negative over 5 and 3 years, the April 2025 cybersecurity breach (FY2025 operating income -41.1% on USIM replacement, fee waivers and the customer appreciation package) showing trust is fragile, and a chaebol governance / Korea discount. Gross margin is not presented in its IFRS filings (no cost-of-revenue tag in fundamentals.json); FY2024 operating margin was ~9.4% on KRW figures. A 5 gives CAP = 8.5 years.
name: SK Telecom Co., Ltd.
one_liner: Korea's #1 carrier, moat 5/10 — at $31.96 the ADS sits essentially at the 15% hurdle on the pre-breach FY2022-24 median base ($4.36/ADS): weighted IRR 14.8%, weighted IV@15% $31.40 vs $31.96 price, Tier C sized to the bear end (bear IRR 11.5%); clears 15% only below ~$31.40, and the breach-hit FY2025 is not yet in the engine's base.
